segments.contextAfter: Surface subdivision creates a smooth mesh from a coarse mesh by splitting each primitive (triangle or quad) in the original mesh into multiple smaller primitives and projecting the newly created vertices along surface normal vectors.

segments.contextAfter: The `subdivisionLevels` parameter controls the level of detail (and resulting performance cost) of the subdivision process.

segments.contextBefore: Surface subdivision creates a smooth mesh from a coarse mesh by splitting each primitive (triangle or quad) in the original mesh into multiple smaller primitives and projecting the newly created vertices along surface normal vectors.
segments.contextAfter: For example, in a triangle mesh, a subdivision level of 1 replaces each triangle with a set of four smaller triangles; a subdivision level of 2 replaces each of those four triangles with four even smaller triangles (for a total of 16 created from the triangle in the original mesh.
